title: Store and retrieve
summary: Run a stacker crane from a chart: store each box in the first free cell and bring a box back when its request button is pressed.
scope: Passing means your program behaved correctly in the simulator on this computer. It says nothing about a real machine, its timing or its safety.
objectives: Write the store and the retrieve sequences of a crane as chains of steps.
Keep a table of occupied cells and the requests that wait, and choose the next job from them.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/Warehouse.sfc.json, add the retrieve chain R_PICK to R_FINISH: take the box out of the requested cell, bring it to the dock and put it on the outfeed.
stages.checkpoint: The IDLE step is the only place where the next job is chosen: a box at the infeed stores, a waiting request for a cell that holds a box retrieves.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, follow the crane: it takes the box onto the fork, retracts, moves to the cell, extends, lowers the fork and retracts again; to retrieve, it reverses the sequence and delivers the box at the dock.
stages.checkpoint: The crane moves only with the fork retracted, every move waits 0.3 s before it trusts InPos, and Green lights after two boxes have left on the outfeed.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then press {{ui:learn.check}}: The starter stores boxes but has no retrieve steps, so a request is never served; add the chain that takes the box out of its cell, brings it to the dock and puts it on the outfeed, and let IDLE start it when a request waits for a cell that holds a box.
stages.checkpoint: Check reports the scenario of this lesson as passed.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: Press Check. ZPLC runs your saved program against the scenario of this lesson, with the plant answering your outputs, and lists every assertion that failed. To watch the plant move, press Run (F5) and open the 3D view.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named stacker-crane-warehouse and contains {{assertions}} assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Watch the fork in the 3D view and read stored: and blocked: in the facts text; blocked stays at zero.
stages.checkpoint: stored counts the boxes at rest in the rack, and blocked stays at zero because the crane never moves with the fork out.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: The EVENTUALLY assertions prove that cells 1 and 2 held a box and that a box reached the outfeed bin; the ALWAYS assertion proves no move was refused and nothing fell.
stages.checkpoint: The grade cannot see which cell a box left from, nor the order of the jobs; it sees the cells, the bin and Green.

hints.text: Choose the cell in a P1 action, which runs once when the step is entered; Bay and Level can be set in the same action and they keep their value.
Wait for the step time of 0.3 s and for InPos before extending the fork, and change Bay or Level only in a step where the fork is retracted.

faultCases: The starter stores boxes but has no retrieve steps, so a request is never served; add the chain that takes the box out of its cell, brings it to the dock and puts it on the outfeed, and let IDLE start it when a request waits for a cell that holds a box.
